message:
## Vulnerability Digest

No newly reported vulnerability was confirmed to affect the normalized DLL/component inventory during this 24-hour window.

**Scope:** `DLL_software_component.txt` only, normalized and deduplicated. `Products.txt` and `List_of_SIA_Completed.txt` were not read or combined.

**Scan window:** 2026-10-17 07:40 UTC through 2026-10-18 07:40 UTC (2026-10-17 13:10 IST through 2026-10-18 13:10 IST).

### Findings

No confirmed relevant findings.

Fresh and newly updated CVE/advisory records were checked against the listed DLLs, SDKs, NuGet packages, JavaScript libraries, and obvious product aliases. Candidates were excluded when they were stale, unverified, or only mentioned an in-scope name in the context of an unrelated product. Source coverage included the [GitHub Advisory Database](https://github.com/advisories), vendor advisories, CVE/NVD-indexed records, and CISA sources.

### Possible matches needing review

None.

### MongoDB ecosystem verification

A dedicated sweep checked MongoDB Server Community and Enterprise, `mongod`, `mongos`, Atlas and Atlas services, Ops Manager, Cloud Manager, Compass, `mongosh`, Database Tools, Kubernetes Operator, official drivers and connectors, BI Connector, Charts, Realm/App Services, MongoDB-owned notices, CVE/NVD records, GitHub Security Advisories, and CISA sources. No credible MongoDB-family vulnerability was newly reported or materially updated within the scan window. The newest official MongoDB security entries found were dated October 13, 2026 and were excluded as stale. Sources: [MongoDB Alerts](https://www.mongodb.com/resources/products/alerts), [MongoDB Security Bulletins Archive](https://www.mongodb.com/resources/products/mongodb-security-bulletins/archive), and [GitHub Advisory Database](https://github.com/advisories).

### Review priority

No immediate vulnerability review is indicated from this scan. Continue routine monitoring and normal patch management for previously disclosed issues.
